```python
def solution():
    # Define variables
    purchase_price = 40
    sale_price = 55
    shares = 200
    discount = 0.15
    holding_period = 1.5

    # Calculate the discounted purchase price and total gain
    discounted_purchase_price = purchase_price * (1 - discount)
    total_gain = (sale_price - discounted_purchase_price) * shares

    # Shares held less than two years have the full gain treated as ordinary income
    taxable_income = total_gain if holding_period < 2 else discount * purchase_price * shares

    # Return taxable income rounded to the nearest dollar
    return round(taxable_income)
```
